shared_input_contract.xyz_mm: float32[N,3], original FEM node coordinates in mm
shared_input_contract.u: float32[N,3], original signed (ux,uy,uz) displacement components, mm
shared_input_contract.stress: float32[N], original source signed stress, MPa
shared_input_contract.faces: int32[M,3], global boundary connectivity from original TETRA10 nodes

target_policy: Raw signed displacement components and raw source signed stress; no abs, no reconstructed VM, no interpolation/resampling of labels.
source_h5_gap: H5 vertices are reordered but nodal variables retain CSV GRID ordering; H5 may omit ver_x_disp(mm). Coordinate-align all raw CSV fields.
preservation: New raw-source geometry inputs and coordinate-aligned CSV fields; older prepared inputs/results untouched.
label_alignment: official CSV GRID coordinates -> H5 vertices
selection_policy: Substitute first 50 CADs in the pinned official HF archive order, round-robin ver/hor/dia/tor. The slides' seed-2026 subset of an unavailable 270-CAD pool is unknown and is not reconstructed.
